item.title: You’re a Wizard Stuck in a Can of Beans: It does exactly what it says on the tin
item.description: Escape a tin of expired legumes in You’re a Wizard Stuck in a Can of Beans. This Zine Quest RPG by Lorena Torres Loaiza is a pocket maze zine for solo play

item.title: Tales of Argosa: Islands and Unseasons
item.description: Explore the West, a Tales of Argosa setting blending sword and sorcery with coastal horror. Discover island locations like Doomfang Peak, a custom moon-phase calendar featuring magical "unseasons," and a complete D20 wereshark statblock for your naval adventures.

item.title: If You Want Blood…: A heavy metal campaign under the blood moons
item.description: Greedy Gorgon Press returns with a campaign that is metal af. If You Want Blood stitches together classic adventures under the blood moons of Gorgonia.

item.title: Tales of Argosa: Maze of Sunken Ruins
item.description: Explore the West, a Tales of Argosa setting blending sword and sorcery with coastal horror. Discover island locations like Doomfang Peak, a custom moon-phase calendar featuring magical "unseasons", and a complete d20 wereshark statblock for your naval adventures.

item.title: Looney Tunes: The Day The Earth Blew Up Review – A hand-drawn sci-fi triumph
item.description: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck return to the big screen in Looney Tunes: The Day The Earth Blew Up. Read our review of this hand-drawn sci-fi comedy.

item.title: Technical excellence meets economic reality as White Dragon Miniatures announces closure
item.description: After 16 years of high-quality production, White Dragon Miniatures founder Alan announces the company is winding down due to rising costs and US tax changes.

item.title: Maestro Media announces asymmetric lane-battler Avatar: Pandora’s Power
Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Caverns of Tjoscanth
item.description: Explore the nuances of AD&D 1e through the lens of a modern cavern crawl. This preview covers the tactical depth of turn-based exploration, the abstraction of combat rounds, and how classic roleplaying games handle skills without the need for complex modern lists.

item.title: Hasbro CEO claims AI integration is a “clear success” as Wizards of the Coast profits soar
item.description: Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks reveals that AI integration has saved the company over a million work hours, even as Wizards of the Coast reports record-breaking 2025 profits.

item.title: Rogues’ Gambit: Luke Gygax’s unconventional heist adventure
item.description: Luke Gygax launches Rogues' Gambit, a new 5E heist adventure on Kickstarter. Explore the Whispering Tower in the World of Okkorim before the campaign ends on February 24th.
